Seals SKILL.md under .zqk/skills/<name> with content hash, version, issuer,

and timestamp. Use --verify to check an existing seal without rewriting.

Skill load is fail-closed on mismatch unless BYPASS_SKILL_VERIFICATION is set.

  Seal a skill pack after editing SKILL.md
  zqk system seal-skill orchestration-boot
  Verify seal without rewriting
  zqk system seal-skill orchestration-boot --verify

Usage:
  zqk system seal-skill [flags]

Flags:
  -f, --format string      Output format (table, json, jsonl, yaml, csv, json-rpc, stream, agent-prompt, semantic-link) (default "table")
      --issuer string      Seal issuer identity written into frontmatter when sealing (default "system:cli")
  -o, --output string      Write output to file
  -q, --quiet              Suppress non-essential output
      --timeout duration   Timeout for command execution (0 = auto-calculate)
  -v, --verbose            Verbose output
      --verify             Verify the existing seal without rewriting the skill file
      --version string     Seal version string written into frontmatter when sealing (default "1.0.0")

Global Flags:
      --allow-degraded   Allow scheduler-dependent commands to run when scheduler daemon is not running
